name: Soldev
description: City destroyed by Phyrexian War Beasts under Lim-Dul's control.

description_citations.text: "The Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arcum Dagsson laments Soldev crushed by his machines.
timeline.quote: "It cannot be! Soldev crushed, and my machines to blame?"

citation.text: Soldevi Heretic (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Dagsson says machines' betrayal broke his heart.
timeline.quote: "Nothing has ever broken my heart so much as this—the betrayal of Soldev by my beloved machines!"

citation.text: Soldevi Steam Beast (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorine Relicbane warns of dark deeds in Soldev.
timeline.quote: "Rumors persist of dark deeds performed in the depths of Soldev. When will Dagsson heed the danger therein?"

citation.text: Ritual of the Machine (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At Soldev, Jaya, vessel of Mairsil/Dûl, stabs Jodah, and the Adnates use his blood to activate the War Beasts, which level Soldev and the School of the Unseen.
timeline.quote: Jaya stabbed Jodah fatally, revealing that she had been the new vessel of Mairsil/Dûl all along

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Shattered Alliances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah smashes his mirror in Jaya's face, burning away Mairsil and Lim-Dûl and triggering Jaya's spark.
timeline.quote: smashed his mirror in Jaya's face

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Shattered Alliances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dagsson recounts watching Phyrexian machines swallow Soldev and reveals Heidar's plan to awaken more from the glacier, and the guide realizes who he is.
timeline.quote: And now a madman, Heidar of Rimewind , wants to build an army of these constructs.

citation.text: "The Horror at Ronom Glacier", section "The master machinist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Beneath Soldev, Lim-Dul reveals himself as Jaya, stabs Jodah in the throat, and uses his blood to activate the War Beasts, which destroy Soldev.
timeline.quote: There Lim-Dûl reveals himself: all this time he had been Jaya!

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise offers to make Jodah a planeswalker, but he realizes he has no spark and heals himself.
timeline.quote: He quickly gathers the mana for a healing spell and jumps back to his body, healing himself at the last possible moment.

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah chooses to save his friend over his school; he smashes the mirror into Jaya's face and she ascends as a planeswalker, purging Dul and Mairsil.
timeline.quote: she indeed ascends, purging Dûl and Mairsil from her mind

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
